race.title: Barberstown Castle Chase (Grade 3)
race.verdict: KOPEK DES BORDES clearly has a hole or 2 in his jumping but his ability and potential remain under no doubt and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to get back on track. Irish Panther is a clear second choice. KOPEK DES BORDES (FR) IRISH PANTHER BOWENSONFIRE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Kopek Des Bordes (4/9), Irish Panther (3/1), Bowensonfire (10/1), Westport Cove (12/1), Rockstown Girl (100/1)
